Hi!

My name is Sam and I'm from Philadelphia. I graduated from Pomona College in 2026 with a degree in math focusing on statistics. I am now at Carnegie Mellon University getting my Master of Science in Applied Data Science (MADS). I love working with data and especially enjoy making visualizations, and this site provides a neat little place to bring them together.

Outside of statistics, I love to spend time outdoors, rock climb, hike, and bike. I was also the captain of my collegiate track and field team, and when I'm not doing stats, I am usually out for a run!
